name: go-openai-3d58ac5a-blind28-ots
instr:
# Diagnosing a misbehaving go-openai client without a test suite

Since we picked up the current build of this library for talking to a hosted language-model service, a long series of ordinary calls has started handing back wrong data or failing outright. The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what we could see from application code; we were not able to localize any of it ourselves.

Working with an answer the service stored for us goes wrong the moment we ask for anything beyond the basics. Fetching one by its id while passing the optional extras \u2014 the extra sections to include, the obfuscation flag and the numeric starting point \u2014 blows up instead of handing the stored answer back, though calling off and discarding that same stored answer by id still behave. Asking an answer that has fully arrived for its assembled wording hands us an empty string even when the payload plainly holds a block carrying the model's reply. Enumerating the pieces that went into a stored answer ignores the cursor we pass: what goes out over the wire carries the page size and the sort order we asked for, but the piece we said to start after is simply absent, so we are handed the same first page over and over.

Consuming an answer incrementally is broken in two ways. Properly-shaped increments now arrive blank: each one has no kind, no partial wording and no nested answer inside it, so what should be a notice of creation, an increment carrying "Hell
